basis: GBIF backbone for ranked path, with explicit species/genus correction for Triceratops horridus from PBDB and NHM. Omit class and order absent from GBIF ranked chain under ADR 0002; do not convert unranked dinosaur clades into classes/orders.
conflicts: GBIF Triceratops horridus matches SYNONYM with genus Ceratops; adopted Triceratops horridus in genus Triceratops per PBDB accepted_name and current NHM/Smithsonian accounts.
PBDB phylo class labels differ between Reptilia, Ornithischia and Saurischia in the queried taxa; raw labels are recorded but not inserted into the GBIF-based ranked path.
PBDB aggregated early_interval for Tyrannosaurus and Triceratops includes Campanian; not adopted as final species age range. Profile uses only Late Cretaceous and museum evidence.

species.notes: Henry Fairfield Osborn 于 1905 年命名 Tyrannosaurus rex，属名含暴君蜥蜴之意。本档案以这个具体物种为单位，不把所有大型肉食恐龙都叫霸王龙。
